title: PAP Supply Replenishment Program Tenure Allowance on Refill Item Lists
content:
**Allowance.** When the item list of a refill request is worked out in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, an item is listed when its supply runs out no more than the horizon after the request, the horizon being the schedule's ship-window days together with the lead days, and lead days for time on the program are added to that horizon:

| Whole calendar months from the enrollment date to the handling day | Lead days added |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 4 |
| 24 to 59 | 2 |
| fewer than 24 | 0 |

In words: four days for a patient enrolled 60 or more months, two days for one enrolled 24 to 59 months, and otherwise none.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, handling day 10 May)

- Enrolled 10 May five years earlier: 60 whole months, 4 days.
- Enrolled 11 May five years earlier: 59 whole months, 2 days.
- Enrolled 10 May two years earlier: 24 whole months, 2 days.
- Enrolled 11 May two years earlier: 23 whole months, no lead days.
